stories.title: Spokane man's generosity lives on two years after his passing through organ donation
stories.summary: As a Spokane family reflects on Ken Peacock's enduring generosity two years after his passing, his organ donations continue to transform lives.

stories.title: Deadly two-car collision closes U.S. 101 in Pacific County
stories.summary: The highway is fully blocked, and a detour is in place. Drivers should expect delays and use alternate routes if possible.

stories.title: Port now says SEA Airport had 'limited' notice before ICE arrest
stories.summary: U.S. Rep. Pramila Jayapal said the Department of Homeland Security told her the airport was notified one day before the arrest.

stories.title: Renton driver booked for vehicular homicide after SR 18 crash kills passenger
stories.summary: Troopers said the vehicle missed a curve on the C Street exit, crossed the median and hit a guardrail.

stories.title: Hikers caught outside during brief Tornado Warning in King County
stories.summary: The National Weather Service issued the warning after a trained spotter observed a landspout on Thanksgiving Day. The short warning expired at 12:15 p.m.

stories.title: 5 things to do in western Washington: Nov. 27-29
stories.summary: Explore festive holiday events in western Washington, including Seattle's tree lighting, Tacoma's Zoolights, and Leavenworth's Christmas Town.

stories.title: Rising water, rude awakenings: Thanksgiving flooding hits Brinnon
stories.summary: King tides and heavy overnight rain flooded Brinnon on Thanksgiving, forcing campers from Dosewallips State Park and prompting two rescues, but no one was hurt.

stories.title: SeaTac pauses airport expansion permits for six months
stories.summary: SeaTac City Council pauses airport-related construction permits for six months to assess environmental impacts and protect residents, amid expansion concerns.

stories.title: No injuries after plane's landing gear gives out in Grays Harbor County
stories.summary: The pilot escaped injury Wednesday when a plane's landing gear failed just before takeoff, the Grays Harbor County Sheriff's Office says.

stories.title: Seattle's Union Gospel Mission prepares 1,500 Thanksgiving meals
stories.summary: Volunteers are serving hot meals across the nonprofit's four locations, offering people in need a welcoming place to spend Thanksgiving.

stories.title: 1 hurt, 4 displaced after Wednesday night house fire in Arlington
stories.summary: Four people got out of an Arlington home safely after a fire late Wednesday night. One person was taken to a hospital with injuries.

stories.title: Seattle, King County join efforts to stop ban on transgender athletes in girls' sports
stories.summary: The City of Seattle and King County filed a joint amicus brief on Tuesday in support of the lawsuit against the initiative.
